leaks.name: Deals stalled at proposal
leaks.definition: stage == 'proposal' and days from last_activity_date to 2026-10-31 >= 30
leaks.usd_formula: sum(amount_usd) of those deals (pipeline at risk)

leaks.name: Slow first response on inbound leads
leaks.usd_formula: closed slow-lead deals x (fast win rate - slow win rate) x average won amount

leaks.name: Duplicate leads (exact + fuzzy)
leaks.definition: a later lead row for the same person at the same company; pairs in answer_key/duplicate_pairs.csv
leaks.usd_formula: sum(amount_usd) of open deals opened on a duplicate lead (pipeline counted twice)

leaks.name: Leads missing a required field
leaks.definition: any of company, contact_name, email, industry, company_size, region, source, owner_rep_id is empty
leaks.usd_formula: leads missing email (cannot be worked) x value per worked lead; other fields are a routing/reporting cost, valued at $0

leaks.name: Leads never followed up
leaks.definition: first_response_at is empty (all are inbound and at least 7 days old)
leaks.usd_formula: count x value per worked lead

leaks.name: Rep R02 proposal-to-won rate
leaks.definition: closed deals that reached proposal, owned by the rep; rate = won / closed
leaks.usd_formula: rep's closed post-proposal deals x (other reps' rate - rep's rate) x average won amount
